tone_rule.swept_surface: tone of the section edge it is swept from (face family); exact on V3, 0 px
tone_rule.unit_surface_VS: sum_i max(0,n_i v_i) tone_i / sum_i max(0,n_i v_i); back-facing: |n_i v_i|

mix_rule: Colour Middling Average film by film, front to back, each film 8-bit first: two films C = round((c_0 + c_1)/2) per 8-bit channel exactly; for n films the shader rounds once: C = round(sum_k c_k 2^-(k+1) + c_last 2^-(n-1)) (per-film rounding round((c_k + C_{k+1})/2) differs from it by at most 1 level; checked wf6/check-colour)

solidity.block_film: at each filled->filled block crossing, colour m(v)=sum|v_i| tone_i/sum|v_i| (#808080 from the crux); none on faces open to air
